name: Minotaur Wrecker
description: A massive bull-headed firbolg with a quick temper.

abilities.name: Ramp Up
abilities.description: You must spend a Fear to spotlight the Minotaur. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

abilities.name: Charging Bull
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to charge through a group within Close range and make an attack against all targets in the Minotaur’s path. Targets the Minotaur succeeds against take 2d6+8 physical damage and are knocked back to Very Far range. If a target is knocked into a solid object or another creature, they take an extra 1d6 damage (combine the damage).

abilities.name: Gore
abilities.description: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range, moving the Minotaur into Melee range of them. On a success, deal 2d8 direct physical damage.
